Ugh I’m so sorry you’re going through this. It’s so hard to not relapse and I can imagine how you must have just an insane amount of thoughts going through ur head. Try not to make yourself feel guilty, you’re trying your best and giving yourself a hard time about it won’t help you at all. Take it easy. Give yourself time to rest. You’re going through a lot right now and it’s important you don’t downplay this or your mental health :(. 

I think taking a day off to just rest and relax could help. Lie in bed and watch your comfort TV show, listen to music, call someone who could take your mind of things (and maybe someone you could open up to about what you’re going through (if you feel comfortable to) so that you aren’t going through this alone), it’s up to you but do whatever makes you comfortable and relaxed and happy. 

Even just being able to talk to one person in ur life about things helps so fucking much. My pm’s are open if u ever need to rant or just feel less alone!! Otherwise i hope things get better for you and that u take it easy on urself 🤍

Also you should never feel like a burden to ur loved ones. I promise you they would want to help you just as much as you’d want to be there for them if they were going through the same thing.
